summariesJSON.title: Les Saisons en France
summariesJSON.content: This section outlines the characteristics of the four seasons in France. Spring (Le Printemps) arrives in March and lasts until May, symbolizing renewal. Summer (L'Été) begins in June and ends in August, being the hottest season of the year. Autumn (L'Automne) spreads from September to November, marked by changing leaf colors. Winter (L'Hiver) spans from December to February and is noted as the coldest and darkest season. Additionally, there's an emphasis on the cultural significance of seasons in France, with each season bringing its unique traditions and celebrations.
